data.spec: Explicit user steering now: application backend in Python, frontend TypeScript. New default API runtime will be FastAPI in apps/api, reusing office_procurement/Pydantic AI in-process (not Fastify+subprocess). Python owns SQLite workflow, existing /api routes/SSE, sourcing/ranking, severity approval and alerts. Keep frontend/shared TypeScript types/API response shapes and loopback port3001. Existing TS server remains compatibility reference temporarily; npm dev:server and tests will route to Python runtime after implementation. Other backend owners: coordinate before further TS-core edits; air-quality-api must be ported to Python or explicitly treated as not integrated. No real checkout/payment/WhatsApp enabled.
